content: VHS (charmbracelet/vhs)'s Output command natively supports .gif, .mp4, .webm, and a directory of PNG frames only (confirmed by fetching github.com/charmbracelet/vhs/blob/main/README.md '### Output' section directly). It does NOT support asciinema's .cast format -- a GitHub discussion (#225) requests .cast export as an unimplemented feature. VHS also requires ttyd and ffmpeg on PATH.
